notes: Castle Crush nemá karetní frakce/klany — herní 'Clans' jsou sociální feature pro seskupování hráčů (odemyká se na Player Level 3), nikoli taxonomie karet, proto je pole factions prázdné a faction je u všech karet null. Odemykání karet je místo toho vázáno na tier hradu (Training Castle, Lord's Castle, Genie's Palace, Demons' Hold, Dwarven Halls, Pirate's Bay, Angelic Temple, Summit's Castle atd.). Statistiky jsou hodnoty na úrovni 1 z wiki tabulek.

cards.name: Angel
abilities: She is a medium-ranged troop with moderate health and low damage.
She has the ability to heal 10% of the troops' health in her radius.
cards.description: A graceful angel that heals nearby allie troops.

cards.name: Ape Pirate
cards.description: A monkey driving a cannon? No wonder he gets knocked back from its own blast.

cards.name: Archer's Queen
abilities: Expenses of 8 mana, double the range of ranged troops and increase the damage of ranged units by a fixed number
cards.description: The mighty Archer Queen will lead all your ranged troops and increase their attack!

cards.name: Archer's Tribe
abilities: Spawns 2 archers in each of the 3 lanes
cards.description: The whole archer's tribe will come to help you in battle!

cards.name: Archers
abilities: Spawns 2 ranged, single-target, low health and damage archers.
They are the same units spawned by the Archer's Tribe.
cards.description: These twins never miss the target. Use them at a range!

cards.name: Arrows
abilities: Affects all 3 lanes at once.
cards.description: Helps protect your castle by launching dozens of arrows at those attacking it.

cards.name: Black Knight
cards.description: He has the face of danger, but you can only see his raging eyes!

cards.name: Black Witch
abilities: Turns all troops in her lane into Skeletons for as long as she lives
cards.description: Get ready to be cursed! She will turn all troops in her lane into Skeletons for as long as she lives!

cards.name: Blizzard
abilities: Freezes an entire lane of enemy troops for several seconds
cards.description: Freezes a whole lane worth of rival troops and leaves them there for a while.

cards.name: Bomb
abilities: A spell with moderate area damage.
cards.description: Drop it on enemy troops! Boom!

cards.name: Boneyard
abilities: Spawns Skeletons on the three lanes depending on the number of cards you have after playing it
Spawn location is random; skeletons appear in groups of two
cards.description: Skeletons will randomly spawn on the three lanes based on the number of cards you have

cards.name: Cannon Shot
cards.description: Summon this cannon for a single shot to help you destroy the enemy's castle faster.

cards.name: Catapult
abilities: Siege unit that targets the enemy castle directly rather than troops
cards.description: This siege system will target your enemy's castle from far away.

cards.name: Dark Angel
abilities: Grows more powerful each time an enemy dies
cards.description: This sinister angel will become more powerful every time his cursed enemy dies!

cards.name: Demon
abilities: Special attack burns the weakest enemy troop in its lane
cards.description: The flames of hell will burn the weakest enemy on its lane.

cards.name: Dragon
abilities: Knocks back enemies and attacks with area-of-effect flame damage
cards.description: This fearsome Dragon knocks back enemies and attacks with powerful flames!

cards.name: Dryad
abilities: Regenerates health over time while alive
cards.description: This forest spirit is protected by nature and will regenerate any damage suffered.

cards.name: Dwarf
abilities: Single-target melee troop with moderately high health and low damage.
cards.description: Do not be fooled! He has a giant's courage!

cards.name: Executioner
abilities: High health troop with moderately high area damage.
cards.description: A merciless mercenary that loves to see heads rolling.

cards.name: Fan Dancer
abilities: Throws fans to hit multiple ranged targets from afar (near the range of Archer's Queen)
cards.description: This alluring dancer throws her fans and deals damage to multiple foes from afar.

cards.name: Fortify
abilities: Increases your Castle's health; each successive cast grants diminishing HP
cards.description: Improve your castle's defense by giving it more HP. Every Fortify used will give less HP than the previous one.

cards.name: Genie
abilities: Single-target melee unit with moderate health and moderately high damage.
Can be deployed anywhere on the map, even next to the opponent's castle, marked by a genie pot.
cards.description: The mighty Genie can spawn anywhere!

cards.name: Giant Growth
abilities: Buffs your strongest troop's stats; the spell's own level sets the buffed troop's effective level
cards.description: Your strongest troop gets infused with even more strength! Giant Growth's level changes grown troop level.

cards.name: Golem
abilities: Single-target melee tank with high health and low damage.
cards.description: He rocks hard, but rolls slowly. A livin' stone wall to defend your castle!

cards.name: Gust of Wind
abilities: Pushes all troops (both players') back toward their castles briefly; free to cast
cards.description: Super strong wind that will bring all troops back to their castle!

cards.name: Hollow Knight
abilities: On death, switches sides and fights for whoever killed it
cards.description: A cursed Living armor of an ancient knight. It will always turn sides once it's defeated.

cards.name: Inferno
abilities: Sets an entire lane on fire, dealing damage over time
cards.description: Watch your enemies burn as you set a whole lane on fire!

cards.name: Jester
abilities: Melee unit with moderate health and area damage; each attack knocks back affected units
cards.description: He won't let anyone get close to the castle. And he is not joking!

cards.name: Lightning
abilities: Single-target high-damage bolt that targets the unit with the highest health in the radius
cards.description: Strikes the enemy with the highest HP in the targeted area.

cards.name: Mage
abilities: Ranged unit with moderate health and relatively high area damage.
cards.description: A powerful ancient sorcerer. His magic may wipe out lots of troops at once!

cards.name: Mana Ritual
abilities: Reduces the cost of your next card by 3 mana; this spell's level sets the next card's effective level
cards.description: Your next card will cost 3 mana cheaper to be deployed! The Mana Ritual's level defines the next played card's level.

cards.name: Metamorph
abilities: Transforms into a random troop currently alive on the battlefield
cards.description: This trickster creature will transform into a random troop alive on the battlefield.

cards.name: Meteor
cards.description: Deals great damage to enemies near its explosion.

cards.name: Mud Elemental
abilities: Damage output decreases as its health decreases (it 'melts')
cards.description: A huge mud monster whose health decreases as he melts.

cards.name: Nature Heal
abilities: Heals a percentage of HP to troops in the targeted lane
cards.description: A breath of fresh air (and HP) to your troops in the targeted lane.

cards.name: Necromancer
abilities: Automatically revives allied troops that die in his lane, as long as he stays alive
cards.description: The dreadful Necromancer will bring your troops back to life in his current lane as long as he stays alive!

cards.name: Orc Warrior
abilities: Single-target melee troop with moderately high health and moderate damage.
cards.description: Stronger and scarier than humans!

cards.name: Phoenix
abilities: Gets stronger each time it is reborn from its ashes (revives after death)
cards.description: The legendary Phoenix gets stronger each time it is reborn from its ashes.

cards.name: Pirate
abilities: Single-target ranged troop with moderate health and damage.
cards.description: Since she stopped navigating, weapons have become her new passion.

cards.name: Poison
abilities: Damages all units in the target lane over roughly 5.85 seconds
cards.description: A poisonous swamp that fouls your enemy's troops and deals damage over time.

cards.name: Protection
abilities: Shields targeted troops from critical/high-damage spell and unit hits
cards.description: A protective barrier that can save your troops from critical hits.

cards.name: Rage
abilities: Increases all units' damage by 100% and speed by 70% in the targeted lane for a duration
cards.description: Imagine a lane where your troops are furious, faster and stronger!

cards.name: Reaper
abilities: Melee unit with very low health but very high damage (glass cannon)
cards.description: Death is afraid of him!

cards.name: Resurrection
abilities: Revives all of your troops that died in the last few seconds
cards.description: Bring back to life all your troops that died in the last seconds.

cards.name: Shaman
abilities: Summons spiritual copies of himself to confuse/mislead the opponent
cards.description: This mystic warrior will summon spiritual copies of himself to fool your opponent!

cards.name: Shock
abilities: Hits the targeted area twice with two bolts (first stronger than second), each bolt striking the troop with the highest attack
cards.description: This magic shock will hit the targeted area twice, dealing damage to the troop with the highest attack each time.

cards.name: Siege Ballista
cards.description: Sharp spears come flying from far away.

cards.name: Skeletons
abilities: Spawns 3 low health/damage skeletons
Same unit type spawned by Skeletons' Legion and Skull King
cards.description: Annoying solders that are dead and deadly!

cards.name: Skeletons' Legion
abilities: Spawns three Skeletons (the Skeletons-card unit) in each of the three lanes
cards.description: The legion will cover all the lanes with undead soldiers

cards.name: Skull King
abilities: Accompanied by skeleton minions
cards.description: Always walking around with his best friends, the skeletons.

cards.name: Skull Queen
abilities: Boosts the damage of allied Skeletons while she is on the battlefield
cards.description: The undead Queen will personally lead allied Skeletons in a battle, increasing their damage as long as she's on the battlefield.

cards.name: Spectre
abilities: Steals a portion of each allied troop's 'soul' on the field to boost his own strength (without killing them); the more allies present, the stronger he becomes
cards.description: He steals a portion of the soul of each allied troop to boost his own strength.

cards.name: Spiked Statue
abilities: Retaliates damage against melee attackers that hit it
Cannot attack ranged troops, even at point-blank range
Slowly loses HP over time until it burns to ashes
cards.description: This hellish rock will retaliate damage to all melee attackers that dare to hit it. With time, it will lose HP and will burn itself to ashes.

cards.name: Standard Bearer
abilities: Single-target melee unit with moderate health and damage.
On deploy, teleports all allied troops to his lane and speeds them up.
cards.description: His mightiness makes allied units teleport to his lane and also speeds them up.

cards.name: Stone Statue
abilities: Stationary high-HP blocker used to stall/delay enemy pushes
cards.description: This beautiful decoration will steal time from your distracted enemies!

cards.name: Storm Elemental
abilities: Starts weak but grows stronger the longer it stays alive on the battlefield
cards.description: This elemental being starts weak, but will grow into a powerful storm as long as he stays in the battlefield!

cards.name: Triplets
abilities: Spawns 3 fast, single-target melee Warriors, one per lane
cards.description: Three warriors, each on one lane! Let's see your opponent deal with that!

cards.name: Unchained Demon
abilities: While alive, increases the mana cost of all troop cards in your hand by 3 (does not affect spells)
cards.description: A strong beast that increases the cost of all your troop cards while it's alive.

cards.name: Valkyrie
abilities: Area-damage melee troop
While she is alive on the battlefield, all your cards cost 2 mana less
cards.description: The presence of the mighty Valkyrie in the battlefield will decrease the mana cost of all your troop cards.

cards.name: Vampire
abilities: Heals herself for ~10% of her Attack every 7 seconds while attacking troops (lifesteal-like regeneration)
cards.description: The Vampire is in a bloodlust! She steals life from her enemies, but continually loses her own as long as she is alive.

cards.name: Warrior
abilities: Single-target melee troop with moderate health and damage.
cards.description: A fast and trustworthy resource for battle!

cards.name: Wraith
abilities: Single-target ranged unit with low health and moderate damage.
Immune to damage from spells.
cards.description: A dreadful baroness in life, but now a vengeful ghost that receives no damage from magic spells!
